description.value: Royal Chaska is a full-service Indian restaurant and bar on Fraser Highway in Surrey, offering a broad menu of traditional dishes — from tandoori meats and street chaat to rich curries and biryanis — alongside a well-stocked bar with craft cocktails and beer on tap. The kitchen is led by Chef Sam, who trained at Taj Hotels and Radisson in India before moving to Canada. The restaurant also runs a daily lunch buffet and accepts online orders, making it a practical sit-down stop for cyclists travelling along the Fraser Valley corridor.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Extensive vegetarian options throughout the menu (Aloo Gobi, Channa Masala, Dal Makhani, Malai Kofta, Kadhai Paneer, multiple paneer tikka varieties, Bombay Bhel, Dahi Puri, Papri Chaat, etc.). One reviewer explicitly notes 'many vegetarian options' at the buffet. Drinks menu lists a gluten-free beer ('Whistler Brewing Foreger - Gluten Free Lager'). Jain food available on special request per a customer review
